How to remove the password from a bank statement PDF

Open Remove a password, add the statement, type the password your bank set and press Unlock it. You get a copy that opens without a password; the original is left as it was.

Remove a password →Free. Nothing is uploaded.

How to do it

  1. Open Remove a password and add the statement, or several.
  2. Type each file’s password when asked and tap Unlock.
  3. Press Unlock it.
  4. Save the unlocked copies.

What the password usually is

Banks build the password from details they already hold about you. Often it is your date of birth, your customer ID, or part of your name together with part of your date of birth, in a set pattern. It differs from bank to bank and sometimes between kinds of statement, so check the email the statement came with: it normally says exactly what to type.

Why you might want it unlocked

Loan applications, visa files and accountants often want statements they can open without asking you for a password, and some upload forms refuse locked PDFs altogether. Several months can then be joined into one file with Merge, in order.

If you want the numbers in a spreadsheet, you do not need to unlock it first: PDF to Excel asks for the password itself. See bank statement to Excel.

Share less

An unlocked statement shows your account number and every transaction to whoever opens it. If the reader only needs some of it, hide the rest with Remove areas, which takes the marked parts out of the file for good rather than drawing a box over them.

Questions people ask

I don’t know the password. Can you unlock it?

No. The tool only unlocks a file with the password you type; it does not guess passwords. Your bank’s email, website or branch can tell you the format.

Is my statement sent to a server?

No. It is unlocked in your browser. Your statement and its password never leave your device.

Can I unlock twelve months at once?

Yes. Add them all, type each password when asked, and Save all saves the unlocked copies together.

Your file stays on your device. Foolscap does the work inside your browser, so nothing is uploaded and there is nothing for anyone to keep. How you can check
